        function showAlert(msg, icon = '✨') {
            const box = document.getElementById('custom-alert-box');
            document.getElementById('custom-alert-msg').textContent = msg;
            document.getElementById('custom-alert-icon').textContent = icon;
            box.classList.remove('translate-y-[-100px]', 'opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
            setTimeout(() => {
                box.classList.add('translate-y-[-100px]', 'opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');

        function initAudioEngine() {
            if (!('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;
            window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
            const unlock = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('');
            window.speechSynthesis.speak(unlock);

            const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
            const preferred = ["Samantha", "Google US English", "Karen", "Victoria", "Microsoft Zira", "Fiona", "en-US"];

            for (let name of preferred) {
                const found = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('en') && v.name.includes(name));
                if (found) { selectedVoice = found; break; }
            }
            if (!selectedVoice) selectedVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('en')) || null;

            const badge = document.getElementById('voice-badge');
            if (selectedVoice) {
                badge.textContent = selectedVoice.name.split(' ')[0] + " 🌸";
                badge.className = "bg-green-100 text-green-700 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold";
            }
        }

        if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
            window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = initAudioEngine;
        }

        function speakText(text, buttonElement = null) {
            if (!('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;
            window.speechSynthesis.cancel();

            const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
            utterance.lang = 'en-US';
            utterance.rate = 0.85; 
            utterance.pitch = 1.08; 

            if (selectedVoice) utterance.voice = selectedVoice;

            if (buttonElement) {
                buttonElement.classList.add('pulse-audio', 'bg-pink-200');
                utterance.onend = () => buttonElement.classList.remove('pulse-audio', 'bg-pink-200');
                utterance.onerror = () => buttonElement.classList.remove('pulse-audio', 'bg-pink-200');
            }
            window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
        }

        function renderCategoryCards(containerId, dataArray, borderColor) {
            const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
            if (!container) return;
            container.innerHTML = '';
            dataArray.forEach(item => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = `bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 border border-${borderColor}-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md card-hover flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3`;
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <span class="text-3xl">${item.emoji}</span>
                        <button onclick="speakText('${item.en.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', this)" class="bg-${borderColor}-50 hover:bg-${borderColor}-100 text-${borderColor}-600 font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-${borderColor}-200 transition active:scale-95 shadow-sm cursor-pointer">
                            <span class="text-sm">🔊</span> Écouter
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <h3 class="text-base font-bold text-purple-900 leading-snug">${item.en}</h3>
                        <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">${item.fr}</p>
                    </div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function renderCards() {
            renderCategoryCards('cards-activities', ACTIVITIES_DATA, 'pink');

            renderCategoryCards('cards-emotions', EMOTIONS_DATA, 'yellow');

            renderCategoryCards('cards-body', BODY_DATA, 'teal');
            renderCategoryCards('cards-weather', WEATHER_DATA, 'sky');
            renderCategoryCards('cards-actions', ACTIONS_DATA, 'orange');
        }

        function renderChecklist() {
            const container = document.getElementById('checklist-container');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            let checkedCount = 0;

            CHECKLIST_ITEMS.forEach(item => {
                const isChecked = !!checklistState[item.id];
                if (isChecked) checkedCount++;

                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = `p-4 rounded-2xl border transition flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer ${
                    isChecked ? 'bg-pink-50/80 border-pink-300' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 hover:border-pink-200'
                }`;
                card.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target.tagName !== 'INPUT') toggleChecklistItem(item.id); };
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <input type="checkbox" id="${item.id}" ${isChecked ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleChecklistItem('${item.id}')" class="w-5 h-5 accent-pink-500 rounded cursor-pointer">
                    <div class="flex-1">
                        <label for="${item.id}" class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 cursor-pointer block">${item.fr}</label>
                        <span class="text-xs font-bold text-purple-600 bg-purple-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md inline-block mt-1">${item.word}</span>
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); speakText('${item.word.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', this)" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-pink-500 p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-white text-sm transition cursor-pointer">🔊</button>
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
            });

            const percent = Math.round((checkedCount / CHECKLIST_ITEMS.length) * 100);
            document.getElementById('passport-progress-bar').style.width = percent + '%';
            document.getElementById('passport-percent-text').textContent = percent + '%';

            const certBtn = document.getElementById('certificate-btn');
            if (percent === 100) {
                certBtn.disabled = false;
                certBtn.classList.remove('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                certBtn.classList.add('animate-bounce');
            } else {
                certBtn.disabled = true;
                certBtn.classList.add('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                certBtn.classList.remove('animate-bounce');
            }
        }

        function toggleChecklistItem(id) {
            checklistState[id] = !checklistState[id];
            localStorage.setItem('english_passport_state', JSON.stringify(checklistState));
            renderChecklist();
            if (CHECKLIST_ITEMS.every(item => checklistState[item.id])) {
                triggerConfetti();
                setTimeout(openCertificateModal, 600);
            }
        }

        function resetChecklist() {
            checklistState = {};
            localStorage.removeItem('english_passport_state');
            renderChecklist();
            showAlert("Passeport réinitialisé avec succès !", "🔄");
        }

        // --- MATCHING GAME LOGIC ---
        function initMatchGame() {
            matchScoreCount = 0;
            completedMatches = [];
            isDrawingMatch = false;
            startMatchNode = null;
            tempErrorLine = null;

            document.getElementById('match-score').textContent = matchScoreCount;
            document.getElementById('match-feedback').textContent = "Trace une ligne du mot en anglais à gauche vers sa bonne image à droite !";
            document.getElementById('match-feedback').className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-indigo-600";

            matchRoundItems = [...ALL_VOCAB].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, matchTotalRounds);
            renderMatchColumns();
            setTimeout(resizeMatchCanvas, 100);
        }

        function resizeMatchCanvas() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('match-canvas');
            const wrapper = document.getElementById('match-game-wrapper');
            if (!canvas || !wrapper) return;
            
            canvas.width = wrapper.offsetWidth;
            canvas.height = wrapper.offsetHeight;
            redrawMatchCanvas();
        }

        function renderMatchColumns() {
            const leftCol = document.getElementById('match-left-column');
            const rightCol = document.getElementById('match-right-column');
            leftCol.innerHTML = '';
            rightCol.innerHTML = '';

            const shuffledEnglish = [...matchRoundItems].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
            const shuffledRight = [...matchRoundItems].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());

            shuffledEnglish.forEach(item => {
                const btn = document.createElement('div');
                btn.id = `en-node-${item.id}`;
                btn.setAttribute('data-id', item.id);
                btn.className = "match-node-left relative w-full p-2.5 md:p-3 bg-white hover:bg-indigo-50 border-2 border-indigo-200 rounded-xl font-bold text-indigo-900 text-xs md:text-sm transition flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing select-none";
                btn.innerHTML = `
                    <span>${item.en}</span>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span class="text-xs text-indigo-400">✏️</span>
                        <div class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-indigo-400 border border-white shadow-sm"></div>
                    </div>
                `;
                
                btn.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => startDrawingLine(e, item, btn, 'left'));
                btn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => startDrawingLine(e, item, btn, 'left'), { passive: false });

                leftCol.appendChild(btn);
            });

            shuffledRight.forEach(item => {
                const btn = document.createElement('div');
                btn.id = `fr-node-${item.id}`;
                btn.setAttribute('data-id', item.id);
                btn.className = "match-node-right relative w-full p-2.5 bg-white hover:bg-pink-50 border-2 border-pink-200 rounded-xl font-semibold text-slate-700 text-xs md:text-sm transition flex items-center gap-2 md:gap-3 shadow-sm cursor-pointer select-none";
                btn.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-pink-400 border border-white shadow-sm"></div>
                    <span class="text-xl md:text-2xl p-1 bg-pink-50 rounded-lg">${item.emoji}</span>
                    <span class="flex-1 text-left truncate">${item.fr}</span>
                `;

                btn.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => startDrawingLine(e, item, btn, 'right'));
                btn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => startDrawingLine(e, item, btn, 'right'), { passive: false });

                rightCol.appendChild(btn);
            });

            const wrapper = document.getElementById('match-game-wrapper');
            wrapper.onmousemove = onMatchPointerMove;
            wrapper.ontouchmove = onMatchPointerMove;
            window.onmouseup = onMatchPointerUp;
            window.ontouchend = onMatchPointerUp;
        }

        function startDrawingLine(e, item, element, side) {
            if (e.type === 'touchstart') e.preventDefault();
            if (completedMatches.some(m => m.itemId === item.id)) return;

            speakText(item.en);

            isDrawingMatch = true;
            const pointer = getPointerPos(e);
            const wrapperRect = document.getElementById('match-game-wrapper').getBoundingClientRect();
            
            const elemRect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
            const startX = side === 'left' 
                ? (elemRect.right - wrapperRect.left) 
                : (elemRect.left - wrapperRect.left);
            const startY = (elemRect.top + elemRect.height / 2) - wrapperRect.top;

            startMatchNode = {
                item: item,
                element: element,
                side: side,
                x: startX,
                y: startY
            };
            currentMousePos = { x: pointer.x - wrapperRect.left, y: pointer.y - wrapperRect.top };

            document.getElementById('match-feedback').textContent = `Crayon activé pour "${item.en}" ! Relie-le !`;
            document.getElementById('match-feedback').className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-indigo-600";

            redrawMatchCanvas();
        }

        function getPointerPos(e) {
            if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) {
                return { x: e.touches[0].clientX, y: e.touches[0].clientY };
            }
            return { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
        }

        function onMatchPointerMove(e) {
            if (!isDrawingMatch || !startMatchNode) return;
            if (e.type === 'touchmove') e.preventDefault();

            const pointer = getPointerPos(e);
            const wrapperRect = document.getElementById('match-game-wrapper').getBoundingClientRect();
            
            currentMousePos = {
                x: pointer.x - wrapperRect.left,
                y: pointer.y - wrapperRect.top
            };

            redrawMatchCanvas();
        }

        function onMatchPointerUp(e) {
            if (!isDrawingMatch || !startMatchNode) return;
            isDrawingMatch = false;

            const wrapperRect = document.getElementById('match-game-wrapper').getBoundingClientRect();
            const pointer = getPointerPos(e.changedTouches ? { touches: e.changedTouches } : e);
            const dropX = pointer.x - wrapperRect.left;
            const dropY = pointer.y - wrapperRect.top;

            const targetSide = startMatchNode.side === 'left' ? 'right' : 'left';
            const targetNodes = document.querySelectorAll(targetSide === 'left' ? '.match-node-left' : '.match-node-right');
            
            let matchedTarget = null;
            targetNodes.forEach(node => {
                const nodeRect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
                const nX = targetSide === 'left' 
                    ? (nodeRect.right - wrapperRect.left) 
                    : (nodeRect.left - wrapperRect.left);
                const nY = (nodeRect.top + nodeRect.height / 2) - wrapperRect.top;

                const dist = Math.hypot(nX - dropX, nY - dropY);
                if (dist < 80) {
                    const itemId = node.getAttribute('data-id');
                    const itemObj = matchRoundItems.find(i => i.id === itemId);
                    matchedTarget = { item: itemObj, element: node, x: nX, y: nY };
                }
            });

            if (matchedTarget) {
                if (startMatchNode.item.id === matchedTarget.item.id) {
                    completedMatches.push({
                        itemId: startMatchNode.item.id,
                        x1: startMatchNode.x,
                        y1: startMatchNode.y,
                        x2: matchedTarget.x,
                        y2: matchedTarget.y
                    });

                    const leftElem = document.getElementById(`en-node-${startMatchNode.item.id}`);
                    const rightElem = document.getElementById(`fr-node-${startMatchNode.item.id}`);

                    if (leftElem) {
                        leftElem.className = "relative w-full p-2.5 md:p-3 bg-green-100 border-2 border-green-400 text-green-800 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs md:text-sm opacity-90 select-none shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between";
                    }
                    if (rightElem) {
                        rightElem.className = "relative w-full p-2.5 bg-green-100 border-2 border-green-400 text-green-800 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs md:text-sm opacity-90 select-none shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2 md:gap-3";
                    }

                    matchScoreCount++;
                    document.getElementById('match-score').textContent = matchScoreCount;

                    document.getElementById('match-feedback').textContent = "✨ Super trait ! Bonne association ! 🎉";
                    document.getElementById('match-feedback').className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-green-600 animate-pulse";
                    triggerConfetti();

                    if (matchScoreCount === matchRoundItems.length) {
                        document.getElementById('match-feedback').textContent = "🏆 Bravo ! Tu as relié tous les mots avec succès ! 🎉";
                        document.getElementById('match-feedback').className = "h-8 font-bold text-lg text-purple-700 animate-bounce";
                        triggerConfetti();
                    }
                } else {
                    tempErrorLine = {
                        x1: startMatchNode.x,
                        y1: startMatchNode.y,
                        x2: matchedTarget.x,
                        y2: matchedTarget.y
                    };
                    document.getElementById('match-feedback').textContent = "Oups ! Ce n'est pas le bon mot. Réessaie ! 🌸";
                    document.getElementById('match-feedback').className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-pink-600";

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        tempErrorLine = null;
                        redrawMatchCanvas();
                    }, 800);
                }
            } else {
                document.getElementById('match-feedback').textContent = "Trace ton trait jusqu'à une carte de l'autre côté ! ✏️";
                document.getElementById('match-feedback').className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-indigo-500";
            }

            startMatchNode = null;
            redrawMatchCanvas();
        }

        function redrawMatchCanvas() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('match-canvas');
            if (!canvas) return;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            completedMatches.forEach(m => {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(m.x1, m.y1);
                ctx.lineTo(m.x2, m.y2);
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#10B981';
                ctx.lineWidth = 5;
                ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.setLineDash([]);

                ctx.fillStyle = '#059669';
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x1, m.y1, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x2, m.y2, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            });

            if (isDrawingMatch && startMatchNode) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(startMatchNode.x, startMatchNode.y);
                ctx.lineTo(currentMousePos.x, currentMousePos.y);
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#6366F1';
                ctx.lineWidth = 4;
                ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                ctx.stroke();

                ctx.fillStyle = '#4F46E5';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(currentMousePos.x, currentMousePos.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            if (tempErrorLine) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(tempErrorLine.x1, tempErrorLine.y1);
                ctx.lineTo(tempErrorLine.x2, tempErrorLine.y2);
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#EF4444';
                ctx.lineWidth = 5;
                ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                ctx.stroke();
            }
        }

        // --- QUIZ LOGIC ---
        function initQuiz() { nextQuizQuestion(); }

        function nextQuizQuestion() {
            document.getElementById('quiz-feedback').textContent = '';
            currentQuizItem = ALL_VOCAB[Math.floor(Math.random() * ALL_VOCAB.length)];

            const distractors = ALL_VOCAB.filter(i => i.id !== currentQuizItem.id).sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, 2);
            const options = [currentQuizItem, ...distractors].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
            const optionsContainer = document.getElementById('quiz-options');
            optionsContainer.innerHTML = '';

            options.forEach(opt => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = "w-full p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-100 hover:border-purple-300 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-purple-50 font-semibold text-slate-700 text-left transition flex items-center justify-between text-sm md:text-base shadow-sm cursor-pointer";
                btn.innerHTML = `<span>${opt.fr} (${opt.en})</span><span class="text-xl">${opt.emoji}</span>`;
                btn.onclick = () => checkQuizAnswer(opt, btn);
                optionsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });
            setTimeout(playQuizTargetAudio, 400);
        }

        function playQuizTargetAudio() {
            if (currentQuizItem) speakText(currentQuizItem.en, document.getElementById('quiz-audio-btn'));
        }

        function checkQuizAnswer(selected, buttonElem) {
            const feedback = document.getElementById('quiz-feedback');
            if (selected.id === currentQuizItem.id) {
                feedback.textContent = "✨ Bravo ! C'est la bonne réponse ! 🎉";
                feedback.className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-green-600 animate-pulse";
                buttonElem.classList.add('bg-green-100', 'border-green-400');
                quizStars += 1;
                document.getElementById('quiz-stars').textContent = quizStars;
                triggerConfetti();
            } else {
                feedback.textContent = "Oups ! Réécoute bien et réessaye ! 🌸";
                feedback.className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-pink-600";
                buttonElem.classList.add('bg-pink-100', 'border-pink-300');
            }
        }

        // --- MEMORY GAME LOGIC ---
        function initMemoryGame() { resetMemoryUI(); }

        function resetMemoryUI() {
            document.getElementById('memory-feedback').textContent = '';
            document.getElementById('memory-options-container').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('memory-timer-box').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('memory-start-btn').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('memory-instruction').textContent = "Regarde et mémorise bien ces 6 cartes pendant 13 secondes...";
            
            memoryRoundCards = [...ALL_VOCAB].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, 6);
            renderMemoryGrid(memoryRoundCards, false);
        }

        function renderMemoryGrid(cardsToDisplay, isOpaque = false) {
            const grid = document.getElementById('memory-grid');
            grid.innerHTML = '';
            cardsToDisplay.forEach(item => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = `bg-teal-50 border-2 border-teal-200 rounded-2xl p-2 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-1 transition-all ${isOpaque ? 'opacity-40 filter grayscale' : 'shadow-sm'}`;
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="text-2xl">${item.emoji}</span>
                    <span class="text-[12px] font-bold text-teal-900 leading-tight">${item.en}</span>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function startMemoryRound() {
            document.getElementById('memory-start-btn').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('memory-timer-box').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('memory-feedback').textContent = '';

            let timeLeft = memoryTotalTime;
            document.getElementById('memory-timer-count').textContent = timeLeft + 's';
            document.getElementById('memory-timer-bar').style.width = '100%';

            memoryRoundCards = [...ALL_VOCAB].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, 6);
            renderMemoryGrid(memoryRoundCards, false);

            if (memoryTimer) clearInterval(memoryTimer);

            memoryTimer = setInterval(() => {
                timeLeft--;
                document.getElementById('memory-timer-count').textContent = timeLeft + 's';
                document.getElementById('memory-timer-bar').style.width = ((timeLeft / memoryTotalTime) * 100) + '%';

                if (timeLeft <= 0) {
                    clearInterval(memoryTimer);
                    hideCardAndAsk();
                }
            }, 1000);
        }

        function hideCardAndAsk() {
            document.getElementById('memory-timer-box').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('memory-instruction').textContent = "Hop ! Une carte a disparu. Laquelle manque ?";

            const missingIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * memoryRoundCards.length);
            missingCard = memoryRoundCards[missingIdx];

            const remainingCards = memoryRoundCards.filter((_, idx) => idx !== missingIdx).sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
            renderMemoryGrid(remainingCards, true);

            const remainingIds = new Set(remainingCards.map(c => c.id));
            const candidateDistractors = ALL_VOCAB.filter(i => !remainingIds.has(i.id) && i.id !== missingCard.id);
            const hiddenPool = candidateDistractors.sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, 3);
            
            const choices = [missingCard, ...hiddenPool].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());

            const choicesContainer = document.getElementById('memory-choices');
            choicesContainer.innerHTML = '';

            choices.forEach(opt => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = "p-3 bg-white hover:bg-teal-50 border-2 border-teal-200 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-1 transition transform active:scale-95 shadow-sm cursor-pointer";
                btn.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="text-2xl">${opt.emoji}</span>
                    <span class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">${opt.en}</span>
                `;
                btn.onclick = () => checkMemoryAnswer(opt);
                choicesContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });

            document.getElementById('memory-options-container').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function checkMemoryAnswer(selectedOpt) {
            const feedback = document.getElementById('memory-feedback');
            document.getElementById('memory-options-container').classList.add('hidden');

            if (selectedOpt.id === missingCard.id) {
                feedback.textContent = "🌟 Incroyable ! Tu as retrouvé la bonne carte ! 🎉";
                feedback.className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-teal-600 animate-pulse";
                memoryScore += 20;
                document.getElementById('memory-score').textContent = memoryScore;
                triggerConfetti();
            } else {
                feedback.textContent = `Oups ! C'était "${missingCard.en}" (${missingCard.fr}). Réessaie ! 🌸`;
                feedback.className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-pink-600";
            }

            document.getElementById('memory-instruction').textContent = "Prête pour une nouvelle manche ?";
            document.getElementById('memory-start-btn').textContent = "Manche suivante ➔";
            document.getElementById('memory-start-btn').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        // --- BUILD A SENTENCE DYNAMIC GENERATOR (STRICTLY LOGICAL) ---
        const SENTENCE_TEMPLATES = [
            { type: "animal", prompt: "Look at the cute ___!", fr: (i) => `Regarde ce mignon ${i.fr.toLowerCase()} !` },
            { type: "activity", prompt: "I love ___ on weekends!", fr: (i) => `J'adore ${i.fr.toLowerCase()} le week-end !` },
            { type: "emotion", prompt: "Today I am very ___.", fr: (i) => `Aujourd'hui je suis très ${i.fr.toLowerCase()}.` },
            { type: "clothes", prompt: "I am wearing a nice ___.", fr: (i) => `Je porte un(e) beau/belle ${i.fr.toLowerCase()}.` },
            { type: "food", prompt: "Can I have some ___ please?", fr: (i) => `Puis-je avoir ${i.fr.toLowerCase()} s'il vous plaît ?` },
            { type: "family", prompt: "This is my lovely ___.", fr: (i) => `Voici mon/ma ${i.fr.toLowerCase()} adoré(e).` },
            { type: "body", prompt: "Touch your ___!", fr: (i) => `Touche ton/tes ${i.fr.toLowerCase()} !` },
            { type: "weather", prompt: "It is very ___ today.", fr: (i) => `Il fait très ${i.fr.toLowerCase()} aujourd'hui.` },
            { type: "action", prompt: "I like to ___ with my friends.", fr: (i) => `J'aime ${i.fr.toLowerCase()} avec mes amis.` }
        ];

        function generateRandomSentence() {
            const template = SENTENCE_TEMPLATES[Math.floor(Math.random() * SENTENCE_TEMPLATES.length)];
            const pool = ALL_VOCAB.filter(i => i.type === template.type);
            const targetItem = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];

            const distractors = pool.filter(i => i.id !== targetItem.id).sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, 2);
            const options = [targetItem, ...distractors].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());

            return {
                prompt: template.prompt.replace("___", "___"),
                fullSentence: template.prompt.replace("___", targetItem.en),
                targetWord: targetItem.en,
                fr: template.fr(targetItem),
                options: options.map(o => o.en)
            };
        }

        function initSentences() {
            nextSentenceQuestion();
        }

        function renderSentenceQuestion() {
            currentGeneratedSentence = generateRandomSentence();

            document.getElementById('sentence-feedback').textContent = '';
            document.getElementById('sentence-prompt').textContent = currentGeneratedSentence.prompt;
            document.getElementById('sentence-translation').textContent = "Traduction : " + currentGeneratedSentence.fr;

            const optionsContainer = document.getElementById('sentence-options');
            optionsContainer.innerHTML = '';

            currentGeneratedSentence.options.forEach(wordOption => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = "w-full p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-100 hover:border-pink-300 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-pink-50 font-bold text-slate-800 text-center transition text-base shadow-sm cursor-pointer";
                btn.textContent = wordOption;
                btn.onclick = () => checkSentenceAnswer(wordOption, currentGeneratedSentence.targetWord, btn);
                optionsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });
        }

        function checkSentenceAnswer(selectedWord, correctWord, btnElem) {
            const feedback = document.getElementById('sentence-feedback');
            if (selectedWord === correctWord) {
                feedback.textContent = "✨ Super ! C'est la bonne réponse ! 🎉";
                feedback.className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-green-600 animate-pulse";
                btnElem.classList.add('bg-green-100', 'border-green-400');
                
                document.getElementById('sentence-prompt').textContent = currentGeneratedSentence.fullSentence;
                sentenceScore += 1;
                document.getElementById('sentence-score').textContent = sentenceScore;
                
                speakText(currentGeneratedSentence.fullSentence);
                triggerConfetti();
            } else {
                feedback.textContent = `Oups ! Réessaie de compléter la phrase avec le bon mot ! 🌸`;
                feedback.className = "h-8 font-bold text-base text-pink-600";
                btnElem.classList.add('bg-pink-100', 'border-pink-300');
            }
        }

        function nextSentenceQuestion() {
            renderSentenceQuestion();
        }

        function switchTab(tabName) {
            if (memoryTimer) clearInterval(memoryTimer);

            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(el => {
                el.classList.remove('bg-purple-500', 'bg-teal-600', 'bg-indigo-600', 'text-white', 'shadow-md');
                el.classList.add('bg-white/70', 'text-slate-600');
            });

            const activeTabBtn = document.getElementById(`tab-${tabName}`);
            activeTabBtn.classList.remove('bg-white/70', 'text-slate-600');
            
            if (tabName === 'memory') {
                activeTabBtn.classList.add('bg-teal-600', 'text-white', 'shadow-md');
                initMemoryGame();
            } else if (tabName === 'match') {
                activeTabBtn.classList.add('bg-indigo-600', 'text-white', 'shadow-md');
                initMatchGame();
            } else if (tabName === 'sentences') {
                activeTabBtn.classList.add('bg-purple-500', 'text-white', 'shadow-md');
                initSentences();
            } else {
                activeTabBtn.classList.add('bg-purple-500', 'text-white', 'shadow-md');
            }

            document.getElementById(`section-${tabName}`).classList.remove('hidden');

            if (tabName === 'quiz' && !currentQuizItem) initQuiz();
        }

        function triggerConfetti() {
            if (typeof confetti === 'function') confetti({ particleCount: 80, spread: 70, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
        }

        function openCertificateModal() { document.getElementById('certificate-modal').classList.remove('hidden'); }
        function closeCertificateModal() { document.getElementById('certificate-modal').classList.add('hidden'); }

        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeMatchCanvas);

        window.onload = function() {
            renderCards();
            renderChecklist();
            initAudioEngine();
        };
    </script>
<script>
function createFashionRenderer(records,images){
 const byId=Object.fromEntries(records.map(r=>[r.id,r]));
 function layer(ctx,id){const a=byId[id];if(!a)return;const im=images[id];
 const hairFit={black_bun:[.90,1,0,-12],brown_curls:[1.04,1,0,-6]};
 if(hairFit[id]){const [fx,fy,dx,dy]=hairFit[id];ctx.save();ctx.translate(512*(1-fx)+dx,100*(1-fy)+dy);ctx.scale(fx,fy);ctx.drawImage(im,a.x,a.y,im.width*a.scale,im.height*a.scale);ctx.restore();return}
 if(id==='pink_hair'){const f=.95;ctx.save();ctx.translate(512*(1-f),0);ctx.scale(f,1);ctx.drawImage(im,a.x,a.y,im.width*a.scale,im.height*a.scale);ctx.restore();return}
 if(id==='black_waves'){for(const top of [true,false]){ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(0,top?0:140,1024,top?140:1396);ctx.clip();if(top){ctx.translate(0,140*.20);ctx.scale(1,.80)}ctx.translate(512*.08,-4);ctx.scale(.92,.98);ctx.drawImage(im,a.x,a.y,im.width*a.scale,im.height*a.scale);ctx.restore()}return}
 if(id==='brown_braid'){for(const top of [true,false]){ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(0,top?0:140,1024,top?140:1396);ctx.clip();if(top){ctx.translate(0,140*.22);ctx.scale(1,.78)}ctx.translate(512*.22+4,160*.10-12);ctx.scale(.78,.90);ctx.drawImage(im,a.x,a.y,im.width*a.scale,im.height*a.scale);ctx.restore()}return}
 if(id==='purple_dress'){for(let y=Math.max(0,Math.floor(a.y));y<Math.min(1536,Math.ceil(a.y+im.height*a.scale));y++){const f=y<355?.93:y<430?.93+.07*(y-355)/75:1;let sy=(y-a.y)/a.scale;if(sy>=0&&sy+1/a.scale<=im.height)ctx.drawImage(im,0,sy,im.width,1/a.scale,512*(1-f)+a.x*f,y,im.width*a.scale*f,1)}return}
 if(a.category==='shoes'){const f={black_heels:.98,silver_sandals:.97,gold_sandals:.94,white_trainers:.94,beige_flats:.97}[id];for(const side of [0,1]){const box=a.footBounds[side], [l,t,r,b]=box,center=(l+r)/2;ctx.drawImage(im,side*512,1200,512,336,(side?589:435)+(side*512-center)*f,1480+(1200-b)*f,512*f,336*f)}return}
 if(id==='red_dress'){/* Bustier aminci : rééchantillonnage en lignes entières pour éviter les raccords visibles. */const sourceY=y=>y<350?y:y<473.2?350+(y-350)/.88:y<570?490+(y-473.2)/1.21:y;for(let y=0;y<im.height;y++){const sceneY=sourceY(y),f=sceneY<350?.84:sceneY<570?.84+.16*(sceneY-350)/220:1;const sy=sceneY-a.y,sh=sourceY(y+1)-sceneY;if(sy>=0&&sy+sh<=im.height)ctx.drawImage(im,0,sy,im.width,sh,512*(1-f)+a.x,y,im.width*f,1)}return}
 if(id==='ivory_dress'){for(let y=0;y<im.height;y++){const rise=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(y-540)/120)),fall=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(920-y)/180)),f=1+.06*Math.min(rise,fall);ctx.drawImage(im,0,y,im.width,1,512*(1-f)-9,y,im.width*f,1)}return}
